records.text: Officers treated unattended items near the Fulton Library bus stops as suspicious while canvassing for the shooter's route.
records.speaker: Jennifer Faumuina

appearances.snippet: Yeah, of course. When officers were canvassing the scene, they were also trying to see the route of the shooter as well as just trying to find the shooter. ... And they determined that the Fulton library stood out because there were unattended items there at the bus stops that were away from the courtyard area. And so to them they thought it was suspicious.

verification.notes: The published episode includes the attributed courtroom excerpt in which Sergeant Jennifer Philomena says officers canvassing the route treated unattended items at Fulton Library bus stops as suspicious. Confidence is medium because no separate official court transcript was located.

records.speaker: Anonymous Losee Center Eyewitness

appearances.snippet: No, I agree. And that was my description to the officers on scene about an hour after the shot rang out. ... I went back inside the perimeter and I ran to the command center and I showed them my video. I said, you guys have the wrong guy. ... You got this. It turned out to be George's end.

verification.notes: The published edited recording directly contains the anonymous witness saying he returned about an hour later, went to the command center, showed his video, and said officers had the wrong person, later identified in the program as George Zinn. No official incident report was located to corroborate the underlying events.
